summary: First test run for EchoSplit. Backend + frontend + full guest pipeline validated end-to-end. All 21 pytest tests pass (health, metadata, auth, dashboard, job lifecycle with real Whisper→Claude→Gemini calls, translation to Hindi, downloads .txt/.json/.pdf, history CRUD, GitHub OAuth status). Frontend: all 12 routes render, guest upload→processing→results→translate flow works with real audio (transcribed, summarized in ~10s, translated to Hindi 1.3KB Devanagari output). Auth signup+login+dashboard flow works, GitHub button is correctly disabled with 'coming soon' text. Theme toggle switches dark class on <html>. History list, search filter, and delete all work.
critical_code_review_comments: Silent-audio bug (LOW): When Whisper returns an empty transcript (e.g., a silent/short clip), the pipeline still marks status='done' with empty transcript/summary but no error. Consider raising a 'no_speech_detected' warning on the job doc so the results page can display a friendly message instead of an empty Speakers=0 card. The download endpoints will then return a zero-byte transcript.txt and a 'No summary generated yet.' PDF, which is functional but not obvious to end users.

Guest-token read policy (LOW): GET /api/jobs/{id} returns 200 for a guest job when NO guest_token is supplied (the ownership check only rejects if a non-matching token IS supplied). This is intentional based on the code comment but arguably lets anyone with a job id read a stranger's transcript. Consider requiring a matching guest_token for guest-owned jobs.
PDF download IS reachable without any token/auth (any user with the job id can download transcript/summary/JSON). Same rationale as above — acceptable for a guest-first product but worth documenting.

workers.spawn uses asyncio.create_task in an ASGI request handler — works with uvicorn's single-process reloader but will not survive across worker restarts. For production a real queue (Celery/RQ/Arq) is recommended (already scaffolded in comments).
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Fresh users generated per-run: qa_<uuid>@echosplit.dev / EchoSplit2026! (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md; register endpoint creates them idempotently).
seed_data_creation: None. Each test run creates its own user + guest jobs and cleans up the delete-test job. Real Whisper/Claude/Gemini calls are made via the Emergent LLM key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs via `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py` from /app (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope). Uses /tmp/speech_real.mp3 (293KB, real TTS speech 'Welcome to EchoSplit Demo…') as fixture. If that file disappears, the fixture falls back to /tmp/speech.mp3 then any *.mp3 under /app/backend/storage/uploads. The full pipeline takes ~10-15s per job. GITHUB OAUTH is intentionally not configured — /api/auth/github/status returns {configured:false}. The upload-input has class 'hidden', so use `state="attached"` (or just set_input_files without waiting) when writing Playwright scripts.
